archetypes.name: telemetry-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan hinges on a new ledger row schema, JSON aggregation semantics, and run-log publication path that can silently drift across many scripts and docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed per-round timing contract is internally consistent across ledger emission, timing-report aggregation, resume/re-entry behavior, and run-log publication. Check for mismatches in row columns, step labels, interval attachment rules, accepted/rejected/OOS count sources, and stale artifact handling between the plan and the scoped files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
